proposal_or_none.route: Test whether first-order phase learning is blocked by the real submanifold of the native circuit, and use task-signed negative phase curvature to leave that submanifold when a native phase direction lowers the actual full40 CE.
proposal_or_none.problem: The native architecture can possess a useful coherent phase direction whose first derivative is exactly zero. A real initialization can therefore suppress phase learning even while the value/readout and RY parameters continue to train. This is a possible optimization mechanism, not a representational-rank argument or an intrinsic benefit from phases.
proposal_or_none.changed_causal_link: Change only the update of an existing class-effect RZ parameter: an independently checked negative-curvature phase step can initiate a useful phase change that a zero-preserving first-order update misses. Keep the deterministic state-vector head, rank-one effects, token normalization, signed value/readout, epsilon and full40 CE. Do not add mixed effects, an ensemble, shots, outcomes, a new pooling rule or a new loss.
proposal_or_none.operational_rule: At a prespecified training checkpoint, and only under a separately approved study, check a bounded set of existing effect RZ coordinates for small first derivative and negative curvature of the full training CE. A bounded phase step is accepted only after direct evaluation confirms a decrease of that same full CE; all probe and line-search computation must count against the comparison budget. This is a new optimizer variant and inherits no empirical result from the old head.
proposal_or_none.qualification: One mathematically concrete route for derivation and screening. Relevance to the actual initialization and trained trajectories, research originality, and independent task benefit are all unestablished. A false initialization premise or absence of useful negative phase curvature should stop this route rather than motivate a seed/epoch/coefficient rescue.
proposal_or_none.preserved_scope: The accepted old result remains scoped ordinary L4. This proposal neither retracts it nor advances the project to L5. All stopped experimental families in the packet remain stopped.

proposition_1.claim: Let eta collect the real RY and value/readout/bias parameters, and let zeta collect every parameter that produces an RZ angle in state preparation or the independent class effects. Suppose negating zeta negates all those physical angles while leaving eta unchanged. Then the native full40 CE obeys L(eta,zeta)=L(eta,-zeta). Consequently grad_zeta L(eta,0)=0 and the eta-zeta mixed Hessian block is zero at zeta=0. The exactly real submanifold is invariant under SGD, momentum or coordinatewise Adam updates with zero initial phase momentum and no additive phase perturbation, because their update maps preserve a zero phase gradient. This holds for every minibatch, with coadapted signed real values/readouts and with epsilon=1e-6.
exact_assumptions: Every circuit uses real RY matrices and real CNOT matrices, with RZ as its only complex gates; the packet specifies this gate family.

All relevant RZ angles are zero on the real submanifold. For preparation angles pi*tanh(Wx+b), negating the RZ output rows and their biases negates those angles because tanh is odd. The effect-angle parameter convention must be checked against the executed source.
The feature input, valid-word mask, source feature-copy identity, value/readout/bias parameters and epsilon are held fixed when applying the conjugation map.

The optimizer does not mix a nonzero RY gradient into a zero phase coordinate or inject phase noise. Exact-zero invariance is a mathematical statement; floating-point behavior requires a numerical check.
proposition_1.proof: RY and CNOT are real, and RZ(-a)=conjugate(RZ(a)). Thus every preparation and effect state at (eta,-zeta) is the complex conjugate of its state at (eta,zeta). The squared overlap is unchanged, so the normalized weights, real signed logits and full40 CE are unchanged. Positive epsilon makes the head differentiable even at zero overlap. Differentiating the evenness relation at zeta=0 gives both derivative statements. Re-evaluating any minibatch after an eta update preserves the same relation, so zero-preserving first-order updates leave zeta at zero.
proposition_1.limits: This does not say that the whole model is stationary, that its trained initialization was real, or that phase learning is blocked away from this submanifold. Random nonzero phases, injected noise, or an optimizer that mixes coordinate blocks can avoid the exact lock. It is not a barren-plateau or general convergence theorem.

proposition_2.claim: The invariant real submanifold can contain a phase direction that strictly improves the native full40 CE, rather than merely changing attention capacity. An exact two-token head-API construction has zero first phase derivative and strictly negative second phase derivative for the correct class, with a useful finite phase step and with both token computational-basis probability vectors unchanged.
proposition_2.native_construction: Keep both CNOT rings present. Let C1 and C2 be their computational-basis permutations. Pick a source wire k and a wire j such that C1 maps the basis vector e_k to a nonzero bit vector w with w_j=1. Use first-layer RY_k angles +pi/2 and -pi/2 for the bright and dark token states, respectively; all their other angles are zero. Their final states are C2(|0>+|w>)/sqrt(2) and C2(|0>-|w>)/sqrt(2). Use the plus preparation for the correct-class effect and insert its existing second-layer RZ_j angle theta, with all second-layer RY angles zero. Its final state is C2(exp(-i*theta/2)|0>+exp(i*theta/2)|w>)/sqrt(2). This works regardless of the within-layer RY/RZ order because the other second-layer RY angles are zero. The preparation targets +/-pi/2 lie strictly inside the pi*tanh range and can be fitted at two distinct frozen input feature vectors by one affine output row. Distinct H vectors also permit the affine value map and signed decoder to assign u_bright=0 and u_dark=M>0. This is an existence construction at the documented head API, not a claim about observed examples or the full encoder input range.
proposition_2.exact_loss: The two scores are q_bright=cos(theta/2)^2 and q_dark=sin(theta/2)^2. Hence z_y(theta)=b_y+M*(epsilon+sin(theta/2)^2)/(1+2*epsilon). Set every other class decoder to zero so that its logit is its fixed finite bias; all 40 classes still enter the same CE. If p_y(0) is the full40 correct-class probability, then ell'(0)=0 and ell''(0)=(p_y(0)-1)*M/(2*(1+2*epsilon))<0. For any sufficiently small nonzero theta, delta_z_y=M*sin(theta/2)^2/(1+2*epsilon)>0 while every competing logit is unchanged, so the full40 CE strictly decreases. This is a task-signed loss statement, not an inference from rank or score capacity.
proposition_2.phase_control: The two states and the effect have identical computational-basis probabilities for every theta. In this exact witness, dephased probability-overlap scores are both 1/2, the dephased logit is b_y+M/2, and its phase derivatives vanish. Conversely, changing the signed utility or assigning this effect to an incorrect class can reverse the coherent curvature sign. There is no unconditional coherent gain.
proposition_2.limits: Real8 overlap can achieve the same endpoint attention using a different real rotation; this is neither a Q-over-real expressive separation nor a quantum advantage. Co-adapted values and biases may compensate for a poor attention assignment. The zero phase gradient is therefore an obstruction in the phase-learning block, not a lower bound on the best attainable full-model CE.

actual_model_curvature_certificate.assumptions: Freeze preparation, value/readout, biases and all other class effects. Vary one independent physical RZ angle theta of class r, occurring once in its circuit. Then every token score has the exact form q_i(theta+t)=A_i+B_i*cos(t)+C_i*sin(t), including with arbitrary fixed gates before and after that rotation.
actual_model_curvature_certificate.formula: For each example let D=sum_i(q_i+epsilon), N=sum_i((q_i+epsilon)*u_ri), and m=N/D. Obtain q_i'=(q_i(theta+pi/2)-q_i(theta-pi/2))/2 and q_i''=(q_i(theta+pi)-q_i(theta))/2. With D'=sum q_i', D''=sum q_i'', N'=sum q_i'*u_ri and N''=sum q_i''*u_ri, m'=(N'-m*D')/D and m''=(N''-m*D''-2*m'*D')/D. The exact full40 CE derivatives are ell'=(p_r-1[y=r])*m' and ell''=p_r*(1-p_r)*(m')^2+(p_r-1[y=r])*m''. Average these expressions over the prescribed examples. If G=0 and H<0, continuity gives a nonzero native phase interval in which both signs of a sufficiently small step lower that full CE. For approximately zero G, choose the sign opposing G and verify the actual loss before accepting the step. If the implementation uses a transformed raw angle, apply its chain rule rather than treating its raw parameter as theta.
actual_model_curvature_certificate.why_nontrivial: The symmetry result survives shared feature preparation, signed coadapted readout, epsilon normalization and full multiclass competition. The curvature certificate keeps the normalization derivatives and the full40 softmax curvature term; omitting either can predict the wrong sign. The exact witness establishes that an inaccessible first-order phase direction can have positive task utility inside the same circuit family. The proposed intervention acts on that obstruction rather than changing attention rank.
actual_model_curvature_certificate.proof_or_falsification_route: First verify the gate convention and the global phase-negation/conjugation identity against the actual executed forward. Then compare the displayed curvature with independent autodifferentiation or a controlled symmetric loss perturbation. These checks must include a signed-utility reversal and a wrong-class case, which should reverse or remove the predicted benefit. Any failure of the assumed physical-angle map, conjugation identity, curvature sign, or finite-step decrease invalidates the corresponding theorem-to-code link.

discriminating_prediction.beyond_old_alignment: A real native initialization with a zero-preserving first-order optimizer remains real even when the rest of the model learns; a verified negative phase-curvature step can lower full40 training CE where its phase gradient is zero. This predicts a failure and its intervention at an optimizer/phase boundary, rather than another permutation-alignment score.
discriminating_prediction.separates: The exact witness separates the coherent native phase response from the dephased head with fixed identical diagonal probabilities: the former has task-useful negative phase curvature and the latter is invariant along that same intervention. On real examples, only phase directions shown by the executed circuit to preserve those diagonal probabilities admit this interpretation.
discriminating_prediction.does_not_separate: It does not separate Q from real8 in attainable task risk, since a real model can change attention along another real path. It does not separate useful phases from a generic optimizer benefit without a matched real-control update. It does not attribute the existing Q-minus-uniform result to phases.
discriminating_prediction.actual_relevance_prediction: If this mechanism explains an operational bottleneck of the actual native training, recorded initialization or early checkpoints should be real or sufficiently near the real submanifold, and prespecified phase probes should reveal task-signed negative curvature before a permitted step. If the actual phases are already appreciable and useful, or the relevant phase Hessian has no negative direction at the prescribed checkpoints, reject this explanation rather than forcing a zero-phase initialization solely to create the problem.
discriminating_prediction.independent_empirical_test: Any formal optimizer comparison needs a preregistered collaborator-only GitHub implementation, the same pinned features and same-core head, equal total compute including curvature probes, the original Q optimizer, an analogous real-control optimization intervention, and an appropriate dephased negative control for any claimed diagonal-preserving phase effect. Fit any decision about coordinates/checkpoints on training or designated validation only. A suitable unexposed independent validation cohort is needed to claim reproducible task benefit; the repeatedly exposed correlated test cohort alone does not provide it.
